blurb: Crystal Yoga Studio offers diverse yoga classes including hammock, silks, and hoop styles. They have a bead bar where guests can design intention-infused bracelets or anklets with healing beads and semi-precious stones. The studio also provides hybrid online and in-studio teacher training programs focused on authentic and purposeful leadership.
